Container.Name: openmausbot
Container.Overview:
OpenMausBot is an open-source workspace for AI bots (a Grok Bot alternative): chat with bots that run Claude Code, Codex and other engines, each with its own shell, files and browser. This template runs the official server image from the OpenMausBot project.
First sign-in: open the Unraid terminal and run docker exec openmausbot openmausbot pair then open the printed link in your browser, or paste it into the desktop app or scan the QR code with your phone. Every device must pair once.
Install AI engines (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode...) from Settings, Engines, and sign them in from the app; they are kept in the AppData folder.
Network access: the server answers only private addresses (LAN 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16 and Tailscale 100.64/10) and refuses connections from public addresses. Plain HTTP is unencrypted, so for access from outside your LAN use Tailscale or an HTTPS reverse proxy and set Public URL to that address.
Template maintained by repires; OpenMausBot is developed by Milind Soni (Apache-2.0).

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app, desktop app and phones.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Everything OpenMausBot keeps: settings, bots, workspaces, installed engines and their sign-ins. The container runs as nobody:users (99:100).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address devices use to reach this server; pairing links point here. For example http://192.168.1.10:8799 (your server's LAN IP and the Web port), or an https:// address from Tailscale or a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: LAN access
Config.Description: 1 lets the server listen beyond the container while still refusing public addresses. Without it the server is only reachable from inside the container.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: Name the desktop and phone apps show for this server.

Config.Name: Phone relay
Config.Description: Optional. 1 lets phones pair by QR through MausBot Relay; sign in once first with: docker exec -it openmausbot openmausbot login --relay

Config.Name: Webhook socket folder
Config.Description: Optional, for webhooks (/hooks/*) from the internet. A host folder (for example /mnt/user/appdata/openmausbot-run) that a proxy container such as cloudflared also mounts. Keep it outside AppData, which bots can read.

Config.Name: Webhook socket
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /run/openmausbot/hooks.sock together with Webhook socket folder; then point a Cloudflare Tunnel public hostname (path ^/hooks/, service type UNIX) or Caddy at that socket. The webhook port itself only listens inside the container.

Config.Name: Webhook public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The public https:// address that reaches the socket; the app prints new hook URLs with it.
